sentences.text: William Martin Joel -LRB- born May 9 , 1949 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter and pianist .

Since releasing his first hit song , `` Piano Man '' , in 1973 , Joel has become the sixth best-selling recording artist and the third best-selling solo artist in the United States .	Piano Man	Piano Man (song)
His compilation album Greatest Hits Vol .
1 & 2 is one of the best-selling albums in the US .	one of the best-selling albums in the US	List of best-selling albums in the United States
Joel had Top 40 hits in the 1970s , 1980s , and 1990s , achieving 33 Top 40 hits in the US , all of which he wrote himself .
He is also a six-time Grammy Award winner who has been nominated for 23 Grammy Awards .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award
He has sold more than 150 million records worldwide , making him one of the best-selling artists of all time .	best-selling artists of all time	List of best-selling music artists

Joel was inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame -LRB- 1992 -RRB- , the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame -LRB- 1999 -RRB- , and the Long Island Music Hall of Fame -LRB- 2006 -RRB- .	Rock	Rock music	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Long Island Music Hall of Fame	Long Island Music Hall of Fame
In 2001 , Joel received the Johnny Mercer Award from the Songwriters Hall of Fame .	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Johnny Mercer	Johnny Mercer
In 2013 , Joel received the Kennedy Center Honors , the nation 's highest honor for influencing American culture through the arts .	Kennedy Center Honors	Kennedy Center Honors

With the exception of the 2007 songs `` All My Life '' and `` Christmas in Fallujah '' , Joel stopped writing and releasing pop/rock material after 1993 's River of Dreams .	pop	Pop music	All My Life	All My Life (Billy Joel song)	Christmas in Fallujah	Christmas in Fallujah	River of Dreams	River of Dreams
